policy: Actual game findings from tests and visual/code review, deduplicated by underlying cause. Test fixture and tool configuration mistakes are recorded separately and excluded from game defect counts.

issues.finding: All-cloaked targets caused an early return before contact damage.
issues.resolution: Resolve cloaked contact before target selection.
issues.evidence: Simulation cloak/contact regression.

issues.finding: Continue in a claimed cache did not restore its exit-ready state.
issues.resolution: Derive cache claim from persisted consumed rewards and preserve the spent ward state.
issues.evidence: Cache Continue/idempotency regressions.

issues.finding: Companion hero selection targeted the human's hero.
issues.resolution: Validate a separate safe-waystone companion intention; couch Hero 2 uses their own seat.
issues.evidence: Board and controller waystone checks.

issues.finding: Escape could close the title screen with no start route.
issues.resolution: Title back is stable; a closed title layer is restored.
issues.evidence: Final-file title Escape regression.

issues.finding: Dev sliders initially focused Reset and scrolled their header away.
issues.resolution: Focus the first native range control and start at the top.
issues.evidence: Pointer/pad Dev slider checks and screenshot.

issues.finding: Mouse motion after keyboard input did not restore mouse prompts/aim, and stationary cursor aim was lost while moving.
issues.resolution: Meaningful motion sets mouse ownership; keyboard/mouse share cursor aiming through the native camera.
issues.evidence: Hot-device and projected mouse-aim browser checks.

issues.finding: Hero portraits were drawn below their canvas.
issues.resolution: Use native portrait top-left coordinates and render immediately.
issues.evidence: Hero-selection visual capture.

issues.finding: Late native Shell CSS overrode game layout, crowding phone controls and masking visual styling.
issues.resolution: Apply game CSS after Shell creation; use a phone scale and minimal coarse-pointer HUD.
issues.evidence: Phone portrait/landscape, tablet and TV captures.

issues.finding: Caster effects released during wind-up rather than the native active phase.
issues.resolution: Release bolts, reveals and lures from Attack's active transition.
issues.evidence: Attack timing and full ordinary-action runs.

issues.finding: Damage did not interrupt a revive hold.
issues.resolution: Reset partial revive/binding progress and apply a short interruption without dropping a carried ring.
issues.evidence: Revive-interruption regression.

issues.finding: Large set-dressing props had no shared collision definition.
issues.resolution: Author solid flags in the content data and block their footprint in both navigation maps.
issues.evidence: Schema, path, pair-extraction and normal campaign checks.

issues.finding: Holding Interact through pickup could immediately pass to a nearby willing companion.
issues.resolution: Latch one-shot pickup/pass per gesture while retaining continuous revive and extraction holds.
issues.evidence: Gesture-latch and ordinary touch-extraction regressions.

issues.finding: A stationary mouse over newly created menu elements stole controller focus.
issues.resolution: Move focus on actual pointer motion rather than DOM pointer-over events.
issues.evidence: Hero 2 pad-only waystone navigation.

issues.finding: The controller recovery choice closed its custom screen but left the simulation paused.
issues.resolution: Explicitly resume after reconnect or continue-with-AI.
issues.evidence: Disconnect recovery followed by controller-only pause/Dev navigation.

issues.finding: Malformed checkpoint metadata could pass core validation and break Continue or later completion.
issues.resolution: Validate own room IDs, site ownership, flag types and every statistics field before restoration.
issues.evidence: Malformed/prototype-ID/statistics/site save regressions.

issues.finding: Quitting after a wipe and using Continue could avoid the retry Dread step.
issues.resolution: Persist the safe failure state; Continue reopens Retry and charges once only when retry is chosen.
issues.evidence: Continue-after-wipe Dread regression.

issues.finding: The initial finale camera could frame the party while leaving the dragon offscreen.
issues.resolution: Use a bounded shared sanctum framing that includes the dragon and party.
issues.evidence: Final sanctum visual capture and normal final-file campaign.

issues.finding: Courtyard tutorial cards remained over the route board and ending.
issues.resolution: Clear scene-owned teaching cards on title, board and victory transitions.
issues.evidence: Route and victory captures.

issues.finding: The release of a touch extraction gesture could click a newly opened route-menu button.
issues.resolution: Validate pointer-down screen ownership before accepting a menu click, and clear touch state at menu transitions.
issues.evidence: Real touch extraction followed by an unpaused route-screen assertion.

issues.finding: Selection portraits continued painting detached canvases after leaving hero selection.
issues.resolution: Update portrait canvases only while their selection screen is active and release their references at new-run transition.
issues.evidence: Full browser campaign, attract and replay lifecycle checks.

issues.finding: Possession echoes used a generic claw timeline even when copying a caster.
issues.resolution: Copy the native sword/cast timeline and show class-appropriate rune, pulse or mirror effects.
issues.evidence: Director/normal campaign and shared gameplay checks.

issues.finding: Phantom pulse stopped lesser threats but did not physically repel them.
issues.resolution: Apply a short validated outward displacement together with the reveal/stagger.
issues.evidence: Phantom repulsion regression and all-pair extractions.

issues.finding: Flying Nightmares followed ground-only paths despite the room rule describing flight over partitions.
issues.resolution: Use bounded flight through interior geometry and telegraphed landings.
issues.evidence: Nightmare partition-crossing regression and shifting-room extractions.

issues.finding: The victory tableau showed the default pair after choosing different heroes.
issues.resolution: Build tableau rigs from the current party classes.
issues.evidence: Victory and replay presentation checks.

issues.finding: Standalone pause lacked an explicit quit-to-title route and living parties lacked an abandonment action.
issues.resolution: Add standalone Quit to Title and validated return-to-board confirmation, with the Hub chooser retaining shared route authority.
issues.evidence: Browser pause/Dev path exits through the actual Quit to Title action; shared intent rules remain covered.

excludedFixtureFindings: Cloak test started inside intentional entry grace.
Back locator matched both native navigation and action buttons.
Network pass fixture placed heroes 32 units apart beyond the 28-unit pass rule.
Touch harness ended an already-ended gesture.
Biome schema and Ruff exception-aggregator configuration.
Manual browser advance requires draw:true for current-camera screenshots and mouse projection.
Mouse-aim fixture needed to wait through intentional menu input consumption.
Flight fixture initially placed its destination inside the enemy standoff radius.
